# `modules/EditorPhysicsSim.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorPhysicsSim.js`

EditorPhysicsSim.js - Physics Simulation Management for Editor Manages rope, wire, hair, cloth, and soft body simulations in the editor. Uses PBD solver with OGC contact model for penetration-free simulation.

## Functions

### `initRopeSimulation(editor, entityId, position, opts)`

Initialize rope simulation for an entity

### `initRopeSimulationBetweenPoints(editor, entityId, startPos, endPos, opts)`

Initialize rope simulation between two points (for tool-created ropes)

### `initPhysXRopeSimulation(editor, entityId, startPos, endPos, opts)`

Initialize PhysX articulation-based rope simulation Uses NVIDIA PhysX for more stable, unified physics simulation

### `initGPURopeSimulation(editor, entityId, startPos, endPos, opts)`

Initialize GPU-based rope simulation using unified particle system Uses GPU constraint solver for native rope physics (Phase 2)

### `async initSoftBodyFromMesh(editor, entityId, meshPositions, meshIndices, opts = {})`

Initialize a soft body from an arbitrary surface mesh using AutoTetMesh. Converts the surface mesh to a tetrahedral volume mesh, then creates PBD particles and constraints from the tet nodes.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityId` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `meshPositions` *(Float32Array)* — Surface mesh positions (stride 3)
- `meshIndices` *(Uint32Array)* — Surface mesh indices (stride 3)
- `opts` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `opts.preset` *(string)* — 'preview' | 'balanced' | 'quality'
- `opts.gridRes` *(number)* — Override grid resolution
- `opts.stiffness` *(number)* — Distance constraint stiffness (0-1)
- `opts.damping` *(number)* — Velocity damping (0-1)
- `opts.gravity` *(number)* — Gravity (negative = down)
- `opts.mass` *(number)* — Total mass
- `opts.pinMode` *(string)* — 'none' | 'bottom' | 'top' (auto-pin nodes)

**Returns:** PBD solver or null on failure

### `initBalloonSimulation(editor, entityId, position, opts)`

Initialize balloon simulation (pressure-based soft body)

### `initFluidSimulation(editor, entityId, position, opts)`

### `stepPhysicsSimulations(editor, dt)`

Step all physics simulations

### `syncSimulationsToComponents(editor)`

Sync all active simulation particle data to ECS components. Call this before saving the scene to ensure particles are persisted.

### `initTwistedRopeSimulation(editor, entityId, startPos, endPos, opts = {})`

Initialize a twisted rope simulation with multiple threads Creates helical thread arrangement that twists together like real rope fibers

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — Editor instance
- `entityId` *(number)* — Entity ID
- `startPos` *(Array)* — Start position [x, y, z]
- `endPos` *(Array)* — End position [x, y, z]
- `opts` *(Object)* — Options from TwistedRope component

**Returns:** The solver instance

### `destroyPhysicsSimulation(editor, entityId, options = {})`

Destroy a physics simulation.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — Editor instance
- `entityId` *(number)* — Entity ID
- `options` *(Object)* — Options
- `options.skipSync` *(boolean)* — If true, don't sync particles to component (used when exiting play mode)

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
